basics.name: Thavishka Gamage
basics.label: PhD Student in Industrial Engineering, Northeastern University
basics.summary: I am a PhD student in Industrial Engineering at Northeastern University, where I work with Prof. Alp Akcay on machine learning for decision-making under uncertainty and multi-agent systems. I earned my M.Eng. in Industrial and Systems Engineering and my B.S. in Computer Science at the University of Cincinnati. I enjoy building AI tools for real-world operations, products, and early-stage startups.
